title: Civgraph's central configuration (packages/config, REFACTOR-PLAN.md item 7, P7)
description: The declarative tables of @civgraph/config, as JSON: SITE, API (its constants; prefix() is a function), BINDINGS, RUNTIME_VARS and CACHE from src/config.js, BUILD_VARS and REPO_PATHS from src/node.mjs. tests/unit/config-schema.test.mjs builds this object from the modules and validates it with packages/registries/src/validate.mjs. Nothing reads this file at run time: the modules stay the configuration, and the schema says what shape they must keep. A new entry that fits the shape needs no change here; a new field or kind does.

userAgent.description: The User-Agent of requests to Civgraph's own services and the Wikimedia hosts.

api.description: API: the versions of the public API and its legacy prefix.

bindings.description: BINDINGS: every Pages binding a Function may read, by its name in env.

name.description: The database or bucket name in wrangler.toml.

optional.description: Read when present; answered 503 or a fallback when absent.

retiring.description: On its way out; may already be gone from wrangler.toml.

builtin.description: Provided by Pages, not declared in wrangler.toml.

runtimeVars.description: RUNTIME_VARS: the environment variables the Functions read. Each is a secret (set with wrangler, never in the repository) or a flag.

cache.description: CACHE: Cache-Control policies, by what is being served.

buildVars.description: BUILD_VARS: the environment variables of the build, ingest and publish scripts. A secret has no default; any other has one ('' means unset).

repoPaths.description: REPO_PATHS: fixed repository locations, relative to the repository root, with forward slashes.

origin.description: An https origin with no path or trailing slash.
